I saved the handoff with verdict DONE. I changed no files, and I ran none of the acceptance checks myself because no execution tool was available.

The prior protected baseline run (`baseline-c802e8a5`) passed on the same source digest, `db7ae64a…`. Emscripten 4.0.18 built the port and all 22 tests passed, covering the browser, audio and loop checks. I found no defect to repair, so I left `platform/` and `web/` alone.

I read `loop/acceptance.md`, `platform/README.md` and the baseline artifacts. I did not read `README.md`, `loop/README.md`, `artifacts/README.md` or the source in `platform/` and `web/`, so I didn't look at the source for defects.

These requirements are not covered by the automated checks:
- Door and switch activation in actual gameplay
- OS focus transitions (only a synthetic blur is tested)
- Physical speaker output and musical fidelity
- Save persistence across reloads
- Mouse aiming
- A manual playthrough, which has not been done
- Autonomous repair of the two blind regressions, which is NOT PERFORMED because you asked to omit it
- Live resumption on real runs (the tests use fixtures)
- Design rationale and reflection write-ups
- Historical token and cost usage, which remains unknown

This is not full capstone acceptance. A reviewer pass and a fresh tester run on that digest are still needed.
